predeclared: frozen before any v2 result was produced; no hyperparameter or threshold was selected on test data
data_basis: Yahoo daily OHLCV, O/H/L/C all scaled by adjclose/close (split + dividend adjusted = total-return basis) for features, fills and buy&hold alike
feature_note: morning-star schema v1 market features; position_norm and cash_norm excluded from training (constant in training, state-dependent at replay) and given zero weight at export
label: log(close[t+5]/close[t]) > 0

folds.train: all rows with label window ending before the test year starts (purged by forward_horizon rows)

decision.position: long or flat; on entry shares = cash / signal-bar close, clamped to cash at the fill price; shares held until the signal turns flat (same convention as crucibo equity sizing with clamp_buys_to_cash)

execution.hold_until: open of bar t+2 (next decision fill); last bar marks to close
execution.terminal: any open position is liquidated at the end and charged exit cost

costs_bps_per_side.source: crucibo EconomicsConfig defaults: fee_bps 4 (2/3 of total, on gross) + slippage_bps 2 (1/3 of total, on price)

mlp_shipped_v1.note: morning-star numpy trainer at repo defaults (hidden 8, 80 epochs, lr 0.05, unscaled, 5 features)

uncertainty.method: moving-block bootstrap, block 21 days, 2000 resamples, seed 7
reported: mean daily excess return vs buy&hold 95% CI
uncertainty.caveat: descriptive intervals, not a proof of presence or absence of edge; overlapping labels and few symbols
